unit.why: The division holds homiletic teachings on love of fellows and unity. It quotes a gematria of אהבה from ספר ד״ל and the Alshich's exegesis of Micah 2, and it narrates no event.
unit.boundary_note: Ends a section (סליק אות ה). The next division opens a new section on confession (וידוי) with a story about the Rambam.
